"What do you think about traveling?" Kai admitted to Rose.
Rose paused and then replied, "I think traveling is important because it teaches us generosity."
"I agree," Kai said with a humble smile. "We should talk about this more often."

"Why?" Ibrahim asked, sitting down beside Sam.
"Because I lost my white compass in the desert," Sam explained.
"Do not worry," Ibrahim replied. "I will help you find it. That is what friends are for."
